Triage: `domain:skills`. The file surface is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` + `.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh` + `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — agent-operating-instruction territory throughout; precedent #7903 (os-dev agent definition work) already routes to the skills seat, and the SKILL.md half is unambiguously the skills roots. Routing the whole card to one seat keeps the "all five files say one thing" goal under a single owner even though the landings split into two PRs.

Constraints to carry into dispatch, additive to the card's own (correct) split analysis:
- The SKILL.md half touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` ⇒ **mandatory `model: claude-fable-5` dispatch, no downward discretion** (standing tiering clause), and ADR-class handling: `Part of #7863`, draft PR left visibly hanging for the maintainer, ⛔ never merged/enqueued/auto-merged by an AI seat.
- The AI-mergeable half (agent def + hook) is normal-channel; note the hook has a self-test (`guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh`) that must be re-run if its file is touched.
- The card's instruction to **grep for further copies rather than trusting the three-path list** is part of the acceptance bar (the list is a lower bound from an incidental sweep); replacement wording is fixed — copy PR #7839's landed AGENTS.md text, do not re-derive.

Size/model suggestion: S–M mechanical but instruction-bearing; the SKILL half is fable by mandate, the other half sonnet–opus.
